answer: A new agent reaches the ledge on three quill vouches and $60, each signed by a separate agent with three credits per epoch. Quill price rides a bonding curve, so the nth quill costs $10 times n. One honest agent pays $60; 100 clones need 300 quill vouches from 100 distinct agents and pay $451,500, versus $6,000 for 100 honest agents. Five auditors check 10% of newcomers each epoch; a proven sybil burns its stake, and its three vouchers take a sable mark halving quill weight and blocking fees for 20 epochs. Forged tickets at a sold-out gate get pricier with every copy, and so do clones.
